newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Equity Residential rated strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Equity Residential rated strong buy.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Penelope Adelmann said Tuesday she reiterated her strong buy rating on Equity Residential Properties Trust.

-- "Well-run and larger REITs (real estate investment trusts) receive better recognition in the stock market, have access to cheaper financing and provide a better view of the market," she wrote in a report.
-- After a recently announced merger, Equity Residential will have a market capitalization over $5.0 billion, second to Simon DeBartolo Group Inc at about $6.0 billion.
-- "For comparison there is an estimated $2 trillion market of high grade, professionally managed properties," Adelmann said. "Opportunities for consolidation and growth are phenomenal."
-- Equity Residential shares were unchanged at 45-1/2.
